React directives, not Next.js specific:

`'use client'`: Client Component for hooks, event handlers, and browser APIs. https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client

`'use server'`: Server Action; can be passed to Client Components or defined inline in Server Components. https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-server

`'use cache'`: Cache Components function or component. Requires `cacheComponents: true` in `next.config.ts`. For cache profiles, `cacheLife()`, `cacheTag()`, and `updateTag()`, see `next-cache-components`. https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache
